name: Room to Make
thesis: An intimate midnight-purple portrait of Raygen, with monumental lavender lettering wrapped around his real avatar and Hack Club artwork. A personal letter closes a sequence about making space for people, making software, and making machines.
interaction: Switch between ‘Things I make’ and ‘People I help make things’: the headline changes, the portrait shrinks aside, SERV0 enters the composition, and the introduction and reading link change. The switch also works with arrow keys, Home, and End.
why: Carries the oversized image-and-type confidence of 06 into the personal purple world of 05. Teaching at One Stone and community work lead the opening; Outpost support for 20+ teenagers, VEX shop leadership, Stardance software contributions, and three open-source printers build a fuller portrait before an intimate first-person letter.
